review_notes: I read the whole file (one theorem and one instance) and checked how Mathlib defines `CostructuredArrow.toOver`. The file adds no `@[simp]` lemmas, no simp sets and no rewrite rules, so it has no simp interface that could loop, compete or expand unwantedly. I found no missing canonical simp lemma that the file's uses would justify. I did not run Lean, so this is a reading of the source only.
